title: Guided Collision Budget v1

result.status_reason: The budgeted continuous-sweep planner, fixed phase/thresholds, critical-state closest-point escalation, deterministic degradation without same-frame retry, diagnostics and legacy rollback are implemented and fixture-verified. Live S2 evidence is blocked by the non-interactive Windows input desktop.

Average and hard query budgets with explicit degraded/rejected outcomes and no infinite retry.
Hit, potential-miss, diagnostics and legacy five-query rollback boundary.
